sentences.zh: 【唐紀七十七】 起強圉大荒落，盡屠維協洽，凡三年。

translations.literal: [Tang Records 77] From Qiangyu Dahungluo through Tuwei Xiexia; three years in all.
translations.idiomatic: [Tang Records 77] From Qiangyu Dahungluo through Tuwei Xiexia—three years in all.

sentences.zh: 昭宗聖穆景文孝皇帝中之上乾寧四年（

translations.literal: The middle section, upper part, of the reign of Emperor Zhaozong, the Sagely, Solemn, Illustrious, Cultured, and Filial—Qianning, year four (
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhaozong—middle section, upper part—Qianning, year four (

sentences.zh: 丁巳，公元八九七年）

translations.literal: dingsi, corresponding to the year 897 of the Common Era)
translations.idiomatic: dingsi, corresponding to 897 CE)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，甲申，韓建奏：「防城將張行思等告睦、濟、韶、通、彭、韓、儀、陳八王謀殺臣，劫車駕幸河中。」

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on jiashen, Han Jian memorialized: "The defense commanders Zhang Xingsi and others report that the eight princes—Mu, Ji, Shao, Tong, Peng, Han, Yi, and Chen—plotted to kill me and seize the imperial carriage to take it to Hezhong."
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on jiashen, Han Jian submitted a memorial: "The defense commanders Zhang Xingsi and others report that the eight princes—Mu, Ji, Shao, Tong, Peng, Han, Yi, and Chen—plotted to kill me and seize the emperor to carry him off to Hezhong."

sentences.zh: 建惡諸王典兵，故使行思等告之。

translations.literal: Jian hated the princes' command of troops, and therefore had Xingsi and the others lodge the accusation.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian resented the princes' control of troops, and so he had Xingsi and the others bring the accusation.

sentences.zh: 上大驚，召建諭之，建稱疾不入。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly alarmed and summoned Jian to instruct him; Jian claimed illness and did not enter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly alarmed and summoned Han Jian to counsel him, but Jian pleaded illness and refused to come in.

sentences.zh: 令諸王詣建自陳，建表稱：「諸王忽詣臣理所，不測事端。

translations.literal: He ordered the princes to go to Jian and explain themselves. Jian submitted a memorial stating: "The princes suddenly came to my office; the purpose of their visit is unclear.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the princes to go to Han Jian and explain themselves. Jian submitted a memorial saying, "The princes suddenly appeared at my office—I cannot tell what they intend.

sentences.zh: 臣詳酌事體，不應與諸王相見。」

translations.literal: Having weighed the matter carefully, I ought not meet with the princes."
translations.idiomatic: Having weighed the matter carefully, I should not meet with the princes."

sentences.zh: 又稱：「諸王當自避嫌疑，不可輕為舉措。

translations.literal: He also stated: "The princes should themselves avoid suspicion and must not act rashly.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote, "The princes should themselves avoid arousing suspicion and must not act rashly.

sentences.zh: 陛下若以友愛含容，請依舊制，令歸十六宅，妙選師傅，教以詩書，不令典兵預政。」

translations.literal: If Your Majesty wishes to show fraternal affection and forbearance, I ask that the old system be followed: have them return to the Sixteen Residences, choose excellent tutors with care, instruct them in the classics, and do not let them command troops or take part in government."
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty wishes to show brotherly affection and forbearance, I ask that the old system be restored: send them back to the Sixteen Residences, choose excellent tutors with care, instruct them in the classics, and do not let them command troops or take part in government."

sentences.zh: 且曰：「乞散彼烏合之兵，用光麟趾之化。」

translations.literal: He also said: "I beg that those rabble troops be dispersed, so that the transforming virtue of the unicorn's hoof may shine forth."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "I beg that those mob-like troops be disbanded, so that the court may again display the virtue of orderly kinship."

sentences.zh: 建慮上不從，仍引麾下精兵圍行宮，表疏連上。

translations.literal: Jian feared the emperor would not comply, and therefore led his elite troops to surround the traveling palace, submitting memorial after memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing the emperor would refuse, Han Jian led his elite troops to surround the traveling palace and sent up memorial after memorial.

sentences.zh: 上不得已，是夕，詔諸王所領軍士並縱歸田裡，諸王勒歸十六宅，其甲兵並委韓建收掌。

translations.literal: The emperor had no choice. That evening he issued an edict: all soldiers under the princes' command were to be released to return to their home districts; the princes were compelled to return to the Sixteen Residences; and all their armor and weapons were entrusted to Han Jian for safekeeping.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had no choice. That evening he issued an edict: all soldiers under the princes' command were to be sent home to their districts; the princes were compelled to return to the Sixteen Residences; and all their armor and weapons were placed in Han Jian's custody.

sentences.zh: 建又奏：「陛下選賢任能，足清禍亂，何必別置殿後四軍。

translations.literal: Jian memorialized again: "Your Majesty selects the worthy and employs the capable—enough to clear away turmoil. Why must there be a separate establishment of the four Rear-Guard armies?
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian memorialized again: "Your Majesty selects the worthy and employs the capable—enough to put down disorder. Why maintain a separate establishment of the four Rear-Guard armies?

sentences.zh: 縱有厚薄之恩，乖無偏無黨之道。

translations.literal: Even if there is favor shown in unequal measure, this violates the principle of impartiality without faction.
translations.idiomatic: Even granting unequal favor, this violates the principle of ruling without partiality or faction.

sentences.zh: 且所聚皆坊市無賴奸猾之徒，平居猶思禍變，臨難必不為用，而使之張弓挾刃，密邇皇輿，臣竊寒心，乞皆罷。」

translations.literal: Moreover, those gathered are riffraff and cunning scoundrels from the wards and markets; in ordinary times they still plot mischief, and in crisis they will surely prove useless—yet they are made to draw bows and carry blades close beside the imperial carriage. Your servant is inwardly chilled with fear and begs that they all be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, those gathered are idle ruffians and cunning scoundrels from the wards and markets; in ordinary times they still plot trouble, and in crisis they will surely prove useless—yet they are made to draw bows and carry blades hard by the imperial carriage. I am chilled with fear and beg that they all be abolished."

sentences.zh: 遣詔亦從之。

translations.literal: An edict was sent forth, and this too was granted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued, and this too was granted.

sentences.zh: 於是殿後四軍二萬餘人悉散，天子之親軍盡矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon the more than twenty thousand men of the four Rear-Guard armies were all dispersed, and the emperor's personal forces were entirely gone.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the more than twenty thousand men of the four Rear-Guard armies were all disbanded, and the emperor's personal forces were gone entirely.

sentences.zh: 捧日都頭李筠，石門扈從功第一，建復奏斬於大雲橋。

translations.literal: Li Yun, chief of the Sun-Upholding Command, whose service at Shimen in escorting the emperor ranked first in merit, was again memorialized against by Jian and executed at Dayun Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yun, chief of the Sun-Upholding Command, whose service escorting the emperor at Shimen had ranked first in merit, was denounced again by Han Jian and executed at Dayun Bridge.

sentences.zh: 建又奏：「玄宗之末，永王璘暫出江南，遽謀不軌。

translations.literal: Jian memorialized again: "At the end of Emperor Xuanzong's reign, Prince of Yong Li Lin went out temporarily to the Jiangnan region and promptly plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian memorialized again: "At the end of Emperor Xuanzong's reign, the Prince of Yong, Li Lin, went out temporarily to the Jiangnan region and promptly plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 代宗時吐蕃入寇，光啟中朱玫亂常，皆援立宗支以系人望。

translations.literal: In Emperor Daizong's time, when the Tibetans invaded, and in the Guangqi era when Zhu Mei disturbed the norm, in each case a collateral branch of the imperial clan was set up to draw popular allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tibetans invaded in Emperor Daizong's time, and when Zhu Mei disturbed the realm in the Guangqi era, in each case a collateral prince of the house was set up to draw popular allegiance.

sentences.zh: 今諸王銜命四方者，乞皆召還。」

translations.literal: Those princes now bearing imperial commissions in the four directions—I beg that they all be recalled."
translations.idiomatic: Those princes now bearing imperial commissions in the four directions—I beg that they all be recalled."

sentences.zh: 又奏：「諸方士出入禁庭，眩惑聖聽，宜皆禁止，無得入宮。」

translations.literal: He memorialized again: "Various masters of esoteric arts come and go within the forbidden court, dazzling and misleading the sacred hearing. They should all be forbidden and not permitted to enter the palace."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized again: "Various masters of esoteric arts come and go within the forbidden court, dazzling and misleading Your Majesty's judgment. They should all be forbidden from entering the palace."

sentences.zh: 詔悉從之。

translations.literal: Edicts granted all of this.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts granted all of this.

sentences.zh: 建既幽諸王於別第，知上意不悅，乃奏請立德王為太子，欲以解之。

translations.literal: Jian, having already confined the princes in separate residences and knowing the emperor was displeased, memorialized asking that Prince of De be established as heir apparent, intending thereby to mollify him.
translations.idiomatic: Having already confined the princes in separate residences and knowing the emperor was displeased, Han Jian memorialized asking that the Prince of De be established as heir apparent, hoping thereby to appease him.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔立德王祐為皇太子，仍更名裕。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict established Prince of De You as crown prince and further changed his name to Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict established the Prince of De, You, as crown prince and further changed his name to Yu.

sentences.zh: 龐師古、葛從周並兵攻鄆州，朱瑄兵少食盡，不復出戰，但引水為深壕以自固。

translations.literal: Pang Shigu and Ge Congzhou combined their forces to attack Yanzhou. Zhu Xuan's troops were few and provisions exhausted; he no longer came out to fight, but only drew in water to form deep moats to secure himself.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Shigu and Ge Congzhou combined their forces to attack Yanzhou. Zhu Xuan's troops were few and his provisions exhausted; he no longer came out to fight, but only drew in water to form deep moats for defense.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，師古等營於水西南，命為俘梁。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Shigu and the others encamped southwest of the water and ordered a floating bridge built.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Shigu and the others encamped southwest of the moat and ordered a floating bridge built.

sentences.zh: 登已，潛決濠水。

translations.literal: When it was complete, they secretly breached the moat water.
translations.idiomatic: When it was complete, they secretly breached the moat.

sentences.zh: 丙申，浮梁成，師古夜以中軍先濟。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the pontoon bridge was finished. Shigu led the central army across first by night.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the pontoon bridge was finished. Shigu led the central army across first under cover of night.

sentences.zh: 瑄聞之，棄城奔中都，葛從周逐之，野人執瑄及妻子以獻。

translations.literal: When Xuan heard of it, he abandoned the city and fled to Zhongdu. Ge Congzhou pursued him; country folk seized Xuan and his wife and children and presented them as captives.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhu Xuan heard of it, he abandoned the city and fled to Zhongdu. Ge Congzhou pursued him; country folk seized Zhu Xuan and his wife and children and presented them as captives.

sentences.zh: 己亥，罷孫偓鳳翔四面行營節度等使，以副都統李思諫為寧塞節度使。

translations.literal: On jihai, Sun Wo was removed as commissioner of the Fengxiang four-fronts campaign command and related posts; Vice commander-in-chief Li Sijian was made military governor of Ningsai.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Sun Wo was removed as commissioner of the Fengxiang four-fronts campaign command and related posts; Vice commander-in-chief Li Sijian was appointed military governor of Ningsai.

sentences.zh: 錢鏐使行軍司馬杜稜救婺州。

translations.literal: Qian Liu sent his campaign chief of staff Du Ling to rescue Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liu sent his campaign chief of staff Du Ling to relieve Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 安仁義移兵攻睦州，不克而還。

translations.literal: An Renyi shifted his troops to attack Muzhou, failed to take it, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: An Renyi shifted his troops to attack Muzhou, failed to take it, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠入鄆州，以龐師古為天平留後。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong entered Yanzhou and appointed Pang Shigu acting military governor of Tianping.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong entered Yanzhou and appointed Pang Shigu acting military governor of Tianping.

sentences.zh: 朱瑾留大將康懷貞守兗州。

translations.literal: Zhu Jin left the great general Kang Huaizhen to defend Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Jin left his senior general Kang Huaizhen to defend Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 與河東將史儼、李承嗣掠徐州之境給軍食。

translations.literal: Together with the Hedong generals Shi Yan and Li Chengsi, he raided the borders of Xuzhou to supply provisions for the army.
translations.idiomatic: Together with the Hedong generals Shi Yan and Li Chengsi, he raided the borders of Xuzhou to supply his army with provisions.

sentences.zh: 全忠聞之，遣嵩從周將兵襲兗州。

translations.literal: When Quanzhong heard of it, he sent Ge Congzhou to lead troops in a surprise attack on Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhu Quanzhong heard of it, he sent Ge Congzhou to lead troops in a surprise attack on Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 懷貞聞鄆州已失守，汴兵奄至，遂降。

translations.literal: Huaizhen heard that Yanzhou had already fallen and that Bian troops had suddenly arrived; he thereupon surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Huaizhen heard that Yanzhou had already fallen and that Bian troops had suddenly arrived; he surrendered at once.

sentences.zh: 二月，戊申，從周入兗州，獲瑾妻子。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wushen, Congzhou entered Yanzhou and captured Jin's wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wushen, Ge Congzhou entered Yanzhou and captured Zhu Jin's wife and children.

sentences.zh: 朱瑾還，無所歸，帥其眾趨沂州，刺史尹處賓不納，走保海州，為汴兵所逼，與史儼、李承嗣擁州民度淮，奔楊行密。

translations.literal: Zhu Jin returned but had nowhere to go. He led his followers toward Yizhou; Prefect Yin Chubin would not admit them. He fled to hold Haizhou, was pressed by Bian troops, and with Shi Yan and Li Chengsi escorted the prefectural populace across the Huai to flee to Yang Xingmi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Jin returned but had nowhere to go. He led his followers toward Yizhou, but Prefect Yin Chubin would not admit them. He fled to hold Haizhou, was pressed by Bian troops, and with Shi Yan and Li Chengsi escorted the prefectural populace across the Huai to take refuge with Yang Xingmi.

sentences.zh: 行密逆之於高郵，表瑾領武寧節度使。

translations.literal: Xingmi went out to meet him at Gaoyou and memorialized that Jin should head the Wuning governorship.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi went out to meet him at Gaoyou and memorialized that Zhu Jin should be appointed military governor of Wuning.

sentences.zh: 全忠納瑾之妻，引兵還，張夫人逆於封丘，全忠以得瑾妻告之。

translations.literal: Quanzhong took Jin's wife into his household, led his troops back, and Lady Zhang went out to meet him at Fengqiu. Quanzhong told her he had obtained Jin's wife.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong took Zhu Jin's wife into his household and led his troops back. Lady Zhang went out to meet him at Fengqiu, and Quanzhong told her he had obtained Jin's wife.

sentences.zh: 夫人請見之，瑾妻拜，夫人答拜，且泣曰：「兗、鄆與司空同姓，約為兄弟，以小故恨望，起兵相攻，使吾姒辱於此。

translations.literal: The lady asked to see her. Jin's wife bowed; the lady returned the bow and wept, saying: "Yanzhou and Yan are of the same surname as the Minister of Works and had agreed to be brothers. Over a small grievance they took offense and raised troops against each other, bringing my sister-in-law to this disgrace.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zhang asked to see her. Zhu Jin's wife bowed; Lady Zhang returned the bow and wept, saying, "Yanzhou and Yan share the Minister of Works' surname and had pledged brotherhood. Over a small grievance they took offense and raised troops against each other, bringing my sister-in-law to this disgrace.

sentences.zh: 他日汴州失守，吾亦如吾姒之今日乎！」

translations.literal: If Bianzhou should one day fall, will I not be as my sister-in-law is today!"
translations.idiomatic: If Bianzhou should one day fall, will I not end as my sister-in-law has today!"

sentences.zh: 全忠乃送瑾妻於佛寺為尼，斬朱瑄於汴橋。

translations.literal: Quanzhong thereupon sent Jin's wife to a Buddhist monastery to become a nun and executed Zhu Xuan at Bian Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong thereupon sent Zhu Jin's wife to a Buddhist monastery to become a nun and executed Zhu Xuan at Bian Bridge.

sentences.zh: 於是鄆、齊、曹、棣、兗、沂、密、徐、宿、陳、許、鄭、滑、濮皆入於全忠。

translations.literal: Thereupon Yan, Qi, Cao, Di, Yanzhou, Yi, Mi, Xu, Su, Chen, Xu, Zheng, Hua, and Pu all came under Quanzhong's control.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Yan, Qi, Cao, Di, Yanzhou, Yi, Mi, Xu, Su, Chen, Xu, Zheng, Hua, and Pu all fell under Zhu Quanzhong's control.

sentences.zh: 惟王師範保淄青一道，亦服於全忠。

translations.literal: Only Wang Shifan held the Ziqing circuit and also submitted to Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Only Wang Shifan still held the Ziqing circuit, and he too submitted to Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 李存信在魏州，聞兗、鄆皆陷，引兵還。

translations.literal: Li Cunxin was at Weizhou; hearing that Yan and Yanzhou had both fallen, he led his troops back.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cunxin was at Weizhou; hearing that both Yanzhou and Yan had fallen, he led his troops back.

sentences.zh: 淮南舊善水戰，不知騎射，及得河東、兗、鄆兵，軍聲大振。

translations.literal: Huainan had long excelled at naval warfare and did not know mounted archery; once it obtained Hedong, Yanzhou, and Yan troops, its military reputation greatly swelled.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan had long excelled at naval warfare and knew little of mounted archery; once it obtained Hedong, Yanzhou, and Yan troops, its military reputation rose sharply.

sentences.zh: 史儼、李承嗣皆河東驍將，李克用深惜之，遣使間道詣楊行密請之。

translations.literal: Shi Yan and Li Chengsi were both fierce Hedong generals. Li Keyong deeply regretted losing them and sent envoys by secret routes to Yang Xingmi to request their return.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yan and Li Chengsi were both fierce Hedong generals. Li Keyong deeply regretted losing them and sent envoys by secret routes to Yang Xingmi to ask for their return.

sentences.zh: 行密許之，亦遣使詣克用修好。

translations.literal: Xingmi agreed and also sent envoys to Keyong to restore friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi agreed and also sent envoys to Li Keyong to restore friendly relations.

sentences.zh: 戊午，王建遣邛州刺史華洪、彭州刺史王宗祐將兵五萬攻東川，以戎州刺史王宗謹為鳳翔西面行營先鋒使，敗鳳翔李繼徽等於玄武。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Wang Jian sent Qiongzhou Prefect Hua Hong and Pengzhou Prefect Wang Zongyou to lead fifty thousand troops to attack Dongchuan, appointing Rongzhou Prefect Wang Zongjin as vanguard commissioner of the Fengxiang western campaign, and defeated Fengxiang's Li Jihui and others at Xuanwu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Wang Jian sent Qiongzhou Prefect Hua Hong and Pengzhou Prefect Wang Zongyou to lead fifty thousand troops against Dongchuan, appointing Rongzhou Prefect Wang Zongjin vanguard commissioner of the Fengxiang western campaign; they defeated Fengxiang's Li Jihui and others at Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 繼徽本姓楊，名崇本，茂貞之假子也。

translations.literal: Jihui was originally surnamed Yang, named Chongben, and was Li Maozhen's adopted son.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jihui was originally surnamed Yang, named Chongben, and was Li Maozhen's adopted son.

sentences.zh: 己未，赦天下。

translations.literal: On jiwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 上饗行廟。

translations.literal: The emperor offered sacrifice at the traveling temple.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor offered sacrifice at the traveling temple.

sentences.zh: 庚申，王建以決雲都知兵馬使王宗侃為應援開峽都指揮使，將兵八千趨渝州；

translations.literal: On gengshen, Wang Jian appointed Wang Zongkan, commander of the Cloud-Deciding Command, as overall commander for opening the Gorges relief, and he led eight thousand troops toward Yuzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Jian appointed Wang Zongkan, commander of the Cloud-Deciding Command, overall commander for opening the Gorges relief route, and he led eight thousand troops toward Yuzhou;

sentences.zh: 決勝都知兵馬使王宗阮為開江防送進奉使，將兵七千趨滬州。

translations.literal: Wang Zongruan, commander of the Sure-Victory Command, was made commissioner for opening the river route, escorting tribute forward, and led seven thousand troops toward Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zongruan, commander of the Sure-Victory Command, was made commissioner for opening the river route and escorting tribute forward; he led seven thousand troops toward Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宗侃取渝州，降刺史牟崇厚；

translations.literal: On xinwei, Zongkan took Yuzhou and received the surrender of Prefect Mou Chonghou;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Wang Zongkan took Yuzhou and received the surrender of Prefect Mou Chonghou;

sentences.zh: 癸酉，宗阮拔瀘州，斬刺史馬敬儒，峽路始通。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Zongruan stormed Luzhou and beheaded Prefect Ma Jingru; the gorge route was opened for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wang Zongruan stormed Luzhou and beheaded Prefect Ma Jingru; the gorge route was opened for the first time.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔將李繼昭救梓州，留偏將守劍門，西川將王宗播擊擒之。

translations.literal: Fengxiang general Li Jizhao went to rescue Zizhou, leaving a subordinate general to hold Jianmen Pass; Xichuan general Wang Zongbo attacked and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxiang general Li Jizhao went to relieve Zizhou, leaving a subordinate general to hold Jianmen Pass; Xichuan general Wang Zongbo attacked and captured him.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，門下侍郎、同平章事孫偓罷守本官，中書侍郎、同平章事朱朴罷為秘書監。

translations.literal: On yihai, Vice Director of the Chancellery and Co-Grand Councillor Sun Wo was removed and retained his original office; Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-Grand Councillor Zhu Pu was removed and made Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Vice Director of the Chancellery and Co-Grand Councillor Sun Wo was removed and retained his original office; Vice Director of the Secretariat and Co-Grand Councillor Zhu Pu was removed and appointed Director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 朴既秉政，所言皆不效，外議沸騰。

translations.literal: Pu, having taken power, found that none of his proposals took effect, and public criticism boiled over.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Pu, having taken power, found that none of his proposals took effect, and public criticism boiled over.

sentences.zh: 太子詹事馬道殷以天文，將作監許巖士以醫得幸於上，韓建誣二人以罪而殺之，且言偓、朴與二人交通，故罷相。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Steward Ma Daoyin gained favor through astronomy; Director of Palace Construction Xu Yanshi gained favor through medicine. Han Jian falsely accused the two of crimes and killed them, and also said that Wo and Pu had dealings with the two—hence their removal as grand councillors.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Steward Ma Daoyin gained favor through astronomy; Director of Palace Construction Xu Yanshi gained favor through medicine. Han Jian falsely accused the two of crimes and had them killed, and also claimed that Sun Wo and Zhu Pu had dealings with them—hence their removal as grand councillors.

sentences.zh: 詔以楊行密為江南諸道行營都統，以討武昌節度使杜洪。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Yang Xingmi supreme commander of the Jiangnan regional campaign headquarters to attack Wuchang military governor Du Hong.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Yang Xingmi supreme commander of the Jiangnan regional campaign headquarters to attack Wuchang military governor Du Hong.

sentences.zh: 張佶克邵州，擒蔣勳。

translations.literal: Zhang Ji captured Shaozhou and seized Jiang Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ji captured Shaozhou and seized Jiang Xun.

sentences.zh: 三月，丙子，朱全忠表曹州刺史葛從周為泰寧留後，朱友裕為天平留後，龐師古為武寧留後。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingzi, Zhu Quanzhong memorialized that Caozhou Prefect Ge Congzhou be made acting military governor of Taining, Zhu Youyu acting military governor of Tianping, and Pang Shigu acting military governor of Wuning.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingzi, Zhu Quanzhong memorialized that Caozhou Prefect Ge Congzhou be appointed acting military governor of Taining, Zhu Youyu acting military governor of Tianping, and Pang Shigu acting military governor of Wuning.

sentences.zh: 保義節度使王珙攻護國節度使王珂，珂求援於李克用，珙求援於朱全忠。

translations.literal: Baoyi military governor Wang Gong attacked Huguo military governor Wang Ke. Ke sought aid from Li Keyong; Gong sought aid from Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyi military governor Wang Gong attacked Huguo military governor Wang Ke. Wang Ke sought aid from Li Keyong; Wang Gong sought aid from Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 宣武將張存敬、楊師厚敗河中兵於猗氏南。

translations.literal: Xuanwu generals Zhang Cunjing and Yang Shihou defeated Hezhong troops south of Yishi.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanwu generals Zhang Cunjing and Yang Shihou defeated Hezhong troops south of Yishi.

sentences.zh: 河東將李嗣昭敗陝兵於猗氏，又敗之於張店，遂解河中之圍。

translations.literal: Hedong general Li Sizhao defeated Shaan troops at Yishi and defeated them again at Zhangdian, thereby lifting the siege of Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong general Li Sizhao defeated Shaan troops at Yishi and defeated them again at Zhangdian, thereby lifting the siege of Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 師厚，斤溝人；

translations.literal: Shihou was a native of Jingou;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shihou was a native of Jingou;

sentences.zh: 嗣昭，克用弟克柔之假子也。

translations.literal: Sizhao was the adopted son of Keyong's younger brother Kerou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sizhao was the adopted son of Li Keyong's younger brother Kerou.

sentences.zh: 更名感義軍曰昭武，治利州，以前靜難節度使蘇文建為節度使。

translations.literal: Ganyi Army was renamed Zhaowu, with its seat at Lizhou; former Jingnan military governor Su Wenjian was made military governor.
translations.idiomatic: The Ganyi Army was renamed Zhaowu, with its seat at Lizhou; former Jingnan military governor Su Wenjian was appointed military governor.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，以同州防禦使李繼瑭為匡國節度使。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Tongzhou defense commissioner Li Jitang was made Kuangguo military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, Tongzhou defense commissioner Li Jitang was appointed military governor of Kuangguo.

sentences.zh: 繼瑭，茂貞之養子也。

translations.literal: Jitang was Maozhen's adopted son.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jitang was Li Maozhen's adopted son.

sentences.zh: 以右諫議大夫李洵為兩川宣諭使，和解王建及顧彥暉。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrance Grandee Li Xun was made envoy to proclaim and instruct the Two Chuan, to reconcile Wang Jian and Gu Yanhui.
translations.idiomatic: Right Remonstrance Grandee Li Xun was appointed envoy to proclaim and instruct the Two Chuan, to reconcile Wang Jian and Gu Yanhui.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，錢鏐遣顧全武等將兵三千自海道救嘉興，己未，至城下，擊淮南兵，大破之。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Qian Liu sent Gu Quanwu and others to lead three thousand troops by sea route to rescue Jiaxing. On jiwei they reached the foot of the city wall, attacked Huainan troops, and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Qian Liu sent Gu Quanwu and others to lead three thousand troops by sea to relieve Jiaxing. On jiwei they reached the city, attacked Huainan troops, and inflicted a great defeat.

sentences.zh: 杜洪為楊行密所攻，求救於朱全忠。

translations.literal: Du Hong was attacked by Yang Xingmi and sought rescue from Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Du Hong was attacked by Yang Xingmi and sought rescue from Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 全忠遣其將聶金掠泗州，朱友恭攻黃州。

translations.literal: Quanzhong sent his general Nie Jin to raid Sizhou; Zhu Yougong attacked Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong sent his general Nie Jin to raid Sizhou; Zhu Yougong attacked Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 行密遣右黑雲都指揮使馬珣等救黃州。

translations.literal: Xingmi sent Ma Xun of the Right Black Cloud Command and others to rescue Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi sent Ma Xun of the Right Black Cloud Command and others to relieve Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 黃州刺史瞿章聞友恭至，棄城，擁眾南保武昌寨。

translations.literal: Huangzhou Prefect Qu Zhang heard that Yougong had arrived, abandoned the city, and led his followers south to hold Wuchang Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Huangzhou Prefect Qu Zhang heard that Zhu Yougong had arrived, abandoned the city, and led his followers south to hold Wuchang Stockade.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，兩浙將顧全武等破淮南十八營，虜淮南將士魏約等三千人。

translations.literal: On guihai, the Two-Zhe generals Gu Quanwu and others broke eighteen Huainan camps and captured three thousand Huainan officers and soldiers, including Wei Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Two-Zhe generals Gu Quanwu and others broke eighteen Huainan camps and captured three thousand Huainan officers and soldiers, including Wei Yue.

sentences.zh: 淮南將田頵屯驛亭埭，兩浙兵乘勝逐之。

translations.literal: Huainan general Tian Yun was encamped at Yiting Dam; Two-Zhe troops pursued him on the momentum of victory.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan general Tian Yun was encamped at Yiting Dam; Two-Zhe troops pursued him on the momentum of victory.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，頵自湖州奔還，兩浙兵追敗之，頵眾死者千餘人。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Yun fled back from Huzhou; Two-Zhe troops pursued and defeated him, and more than a thousand of Yun's followers were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Tian Yun fled back from Huzhou; Two-Zhe troops pursued and defeated him, and more than a thousand of his followers were killed.

sentences.zh: 韓建惡刑部尚書張禕等數人，皆誣奏，貶之。

translations.literal: Han Jian hated Minister of Justice Zhang Yi and several others; he slandered them all in memorials and had them demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian hated Minister of Justice Zhang Yi and several others; he slandered them all in memorials and had them demoted.

sentences.zh: 五月，加奉國節度使崔洪同平章事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Fengguo military governor Cui Hong was given the additional title of Co-Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Fengguo military governor Cui Hong was given the additional title of Co-Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，朱友恭為浮梁於樊港，進攻武昌寨，壬午，拔之，執瞿章，遂取黃州。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Zhu Yougong built a pontoon bridge at Fan Harbor and advanced to attack Wuchang Stockade. On renwu he stormed it, seized Qu Zhang, and thereupon took Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Zhu Yougong built a pontoon bridge at Fan Harbor and advanced to attack Wuchang Stockade. On renwu he stormed it, seized Qu Zhang, and thereupon took Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 馬珣等皆敗走。

translations.literal: Ma Xun and the others were all defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xun and the others were all defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，王建以節度副使張琳守成都，自將兵五萬攻東川。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Wang Jian left Deputy Military Governor Zhang Lin to hold Chengdu and personally led fifty thousand troops to attack Dongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wang Jian left Deputy Military Governor Zhang Lin to hold Chengdu and personally led fifty thousand troops against Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 更華洪姓名曰王宗滌。

translations.literal: Hua Hong's personal name was changed to Wang Zongdi.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Hong's personal name was changed to Wang Zongdi.

sentences.zh: 六月，己酉，錢鏐如越州，受鎮東節鉞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiyou, Qian Liu went to Yuezhou and received the seal and axe of Zhendong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiyou, Qian Liu went to Yuezhou and received the seal and axe of military governor of Zhendong.

sentences.zh: 李茂貞表：「王建攻東川，連兵累歲，不聽詔命。」

translations.literal: Li Maozhen memorialized: "Wang Jian attacks Dongchuan, has kept troops in the field year after year, and does not heed imperial edicts."
translations.idiomatic: Li Maozhen memorialized: "Wang Jian attacks Dongchuan, has kept troops in the field year after year, and does not heed imperial edicts."

sentences.zh: 甲寅，貶建南州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin, he was demoted to Prefect of Jiannan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Wang Jian was demoted to Prefect of Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，加茂貞為西川節度使，以覃王嗣周為鳳翔節度使。

translations.literal: On yimao, Maozhen was given the additional post of Xichuan military governor, and Prince of Tan Sizhou was made Fengxiang military governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Li Maozhen was given the additional post of Xichuan military governor, and the Prince of Tan, Sizhou, was appointed Fengxiang military governor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，王建克梓州南寨，執其將李繼寧。

translations.literal: On guihai, Wang Jian captured the southern stockade of Zizhou and seized its general Li Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Wang Jian captured the southern stockade of Zizhou and seized its general Li Jining.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宣諭使李洵至梓州，己巳，見建於張杷砦，建指執旗者曰：「戰士之情，不可奪也。」

translations.literal: On bingyin, Proclaiming Envoy Li Xun reached Zizhou. On jisi he met Jian at Zhangba Stockade. Jian pointed to those holding the banners and said: "The soldiers' will cannot be taken from them."
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Proclaiming Envoy Li Xun reached Zizhou. On jisi he met Wang Jian at Zhangba Stockade. Wang Jian pointed to those holding the banners and said, "The soldiers' will cannot be taken from them."

sentences.zh: 覃王赴鎮，李茂貞不受代，圍覃王於奉天。

translations.literal: The Prince of Tan went to his post; Li Maozhen would not yield his place and besieged the Prince of Tan at Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Tan went to take up his post; Li Maozhen refused to yield his place and besieged the prince at Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 置寧遠軍於容州，以李克用大將蓋寓領節度使。

translations.literal: The Ningyuan Army was established at Rongzhou, with Li Keyong's great general Gai Yu heading the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: The Ningyuan Army was established at Rongzhou, with Li Keyong's senior general Gai Yu appointed military governor.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，加荊南節度使成汭兼侍中。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Jingnan military governor Cheng Ru was given the additional title of Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Jingnan military governor Cheng Ru was given the additional title of Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 韓建移書李茂貞，茂貞解奉天之圍，覃王歸華州。

translations.literal: Han Jian sent a letter to Li Maozhen; Maozhen lifted the siege of Fengtian, and the Prince of Tan returned to Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian sent a letter to Li Maozhen; Li Maozhen lifted the siege of Fengtian, and the Prince of Tan returned to Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 以天雄節度使李繼徽為靜難節度使。

translations.literal: Tianxiong military governor Li Jihui was made Jingnan military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxiong military governor Li Jihui was appointed military governor of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，錢鏐還杭州，遣顧全武取蘇州。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Qian Liu returned to Hangzhou and sent Gu Quanwu to take Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Qian Liu returned to Hangzhou and sent Gu Quanwu to take Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，拔松江。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Songjiang was stormed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Songjiang was stormed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，拔無錫。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Wuxi was stormed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Wuxi was stormed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，拔常熟、華亭。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Changshu and Huating were stormed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Changshu and Huating were stormed.

sentences.zh: 初，李克用取幽州，表劉仁恭為節度使，留戍兵及腹心將十人典其機要，租賦供軍之外，悉輸晉陽。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Li Keyong took Youzhou, he memorialized that Liu Rengong be made military governor, left garrison troops and ten trusted generals to manage its vital affairs, and required that beyond what was needed to supply the army from tax revenues, all else be sent to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Li Keyong took Youzhou, he memorialized that Liu Rengong be made military governor, left garrison troops and ten trusted generals to manage its vital affairs, and required that beyond what was needed to supply the army from tax revenues, all else be sent to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 及上幸華州，克用徵兵於仁恭，又遣成德節度使王鎔、義武節度使王郜書，欲與之共定關中，奉天子還長安。

translations.literal: When the emperor went to Huazhou, Keyong called up troops from Rengong and also sent letters to Chengde military governor Wang Rong and Yiwu military governor Wang Gao, wishing to join with them in settling the Guanzhong region and escorting the Son of Heaven back to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor went to Huazhou, Li Keyong called up troops from Liu Rengong and also sent letters to Chengde military governor Wang Rong and Yiwu military governor Wang Gao, wishing to join with them in settling the Guanzhong region and escorting the emperor back to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 仁恭辭以契丹入寇，須兵扞御，請俟虜退，然後承命。

translations.literal: Rengong declined on the grounds that the Khitans had invaded and troops were needed for defense, asking to wait until the barbarians withdrew before obeying the order.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rengong declined on the grounds that the Khitans had invaded and troops were needed for defense, asking to wait until the invaders withdrew before obeying the order.

sentences.zh: 克用屢趣之，使者相繼，數月，兵不出。

translations.literal: Keyong pressed him repeatedly; envoys came one after another, but for several months no troops were sent out.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong pressed him repeatedly; envoys came one after another, but for several months no troops were sent out.

sentences.zh: 克用移書責之，仁恭抵書於地，慢罵，囚其使者，欲殺河東戍將，戍將遁逃獲免。

translations.literal: Keyong sent a letter rebuking him. Rengong threw the letter to the ground, reviled him contemptuously, imprisoned his envoy, and wished to kill the Hedong garrison generals; the garrison generals fled and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong sent a letter rebuking him. Liu Rengong threw the letter to the ground, reviled him contemptuously, imprisoned his envoy, and wished to kill the Hedong garrison generals; the garrison generals fled and escaped.

sentences.zh: 克用大怒，八月，自將擊仁恭。

translations.literal: Keyong was greatly enraged. In the eighth month he personally led troops to attack Rengong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong was greatly enraged. In the eighth month he personally led troops to attack Liu Rengong.

sentences.zh: 上欲幸奉天親討李茂貞，令宰相議之。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to go to Fengtian in person to campaign against Li Maozhen and ordered the grand councillors to discuss it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to go to Fengtian in person to campaign against Li Maozhen and ordered the grand councillors to discuss it.

sentences.zh: 宰相切諫，乃止。

translations.literal: The grand councillors urgently remonstrated, and he thereupon desisted.
translations.idiomatic: The grand councillors urgently remonstrated, and he thereupon desisted.

sentences.zh: 延王戒丕還自晉陽，韓建奏：「自陛下即位以來，與近輔交惡，皆因諸王典兵，兇徒樂禍，致鑾輿不安。

translations.literal: The Prince of Yan Jiepi returned from Jinyang. Han Jian memorialized: "Since Your Majesty's accession, strife with those close at hand has all been because the princes commanded troops; vicious men delighted in disaster, causing the imperial carriage to be unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yan, Jiepi, returned from Jinyang. Han Jian memorialized: "Since Your Majesty's accession, strife with those close at hand has all been because the princes commanded troops; vicious men delighted in disaster, causing the imperial carriage to be unsettled.

sentences.zh: 比者臣奏罷兵權，實慮不測之變。

translations.literal: Recently your servant memorialized to abolish their military authority, truly fearing unforeseen changes.
translations.idiomatic: Recently I memorialized to abolish their military authority, truly fearing unforeseen changes.

sentences.zh: 今聞延王、覃王尚苞陰計，願陛下聖斷不疑，制於未亂，則社稷之福。」

translations.literal: Now I hear that the Princes of Yan and Tan still harbor secret designs. I wish Your Majesty would exercise sacred resolve without doubt and control matters before disorder arises—then it would be the fortune of the altars of state."
translations.idiomatic: Now I hear that the Princes of Yan and Tan still harbor secret designs. I wish Your Majesty would exercise sacred resolve without doubt and control matters before disorder arises—then it would be the fortune of the realm."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「何至於是！」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "How could it come to this!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "How could it come to this!"

sentences.zh: 數日不報。

translations.literal: For several days there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: For several days there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 建乃與知樞密劉季述矯制發兵圍十六宅。

translations.literal: Jian thereupon joined with Commissioner of Military Affairs Liu Jishu in forging an edict to dispatch troops and surround the Sixteen Residences.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian thereupon joined with Commissioner of Military Affairs Liu Jishu in forging an edict to dispatch troops and surround the Sixteen Residences.

sentences.zh: 諸王被髪，或緣垣，或登屋，或升木，呼曰：「宅家救兒！」

translations.literal: The princes let down their hair; some climbed walls, some mounted roofs, some climbed trees, crying: "Household-head, save your sons!"
translations.idiomatic: The princes let down their hair; some climbed walls, some mounted roofs, some climbed trees, crying, "Sire, save your sons!"

sentences.zh: 建擁通、沂、睦、濟、韶、彭、韓、陳、覃、延、丹十一王至石堤谷，盡殺之，以謀反聞。

translations.literal: Jian escorted the eleven princes—Tong, Yi, Mu, Ji, Shao, Peng, Han, Chen, Tan, Yan, and Dan—to Shiti Valley and killed them all, reporting it as rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian escorted the eleven princes—Tong, Yi, Mu, Ji, Shao, Peng, Han, Chen, Tan, Yan, and Dan—to Shiti Valley and killed them all, reporting it as rebellion.

sentences.zh: 貶禮部尚書孫偓為南州司馬。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Sun Wo was demoted to Defender of Nanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Sun Wo was demoted to defender of Nanzhou.

sentences.zh: 秘書監朱朴先貶夔州司馬，再貶郴州司戶。

translations.literal: Director of the Palace Library Zhu Pu was first demoted to Defender of Qizhou, then demoted again to Registrar of Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Palace Library Zhu Pu was first demoted to defender of Qizhou, then demoted again to registrar of Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 朴之為相，何迎驟遷至右諫議大夫，至是亦貶湖州司馬。

translations.literal: When Pu was grand councillor, He Ying was suddenly promoted to Right Remonstrance Grandee; at this time he too was demoted to Defender of Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhu Pu was grand councillor, He Ying was suddenly promoted to Right Remonstrance Grandee; at this time he too was demoted to defender of Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 鍾傳欲討吉州刺史襄陽周琲，琲帥其眾奔廣陵。

translations.literal: Zhong Chuan wished to campaign against Jizhou Prefect Zhou Pin of Xiangyang; Pin led his followers to flee to Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Chuan wished to campaign against Jizhou Prefect Zhou Pin of Xiangyang; Zhou Pin led his followers to flee to Guangling.

sentences.zh: 王建與顧彥暉五十餘戰，九月，癸酉朔，圍梓州。

translations.literal: Wang Jian and Gu Yanhui had fought more than fifty battles. In the ninth month, on the guiyou new moon, he besieged Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian and Gu Yanhui had fought more than fifty battles. In the ninth month, on the guiyou new moon, Wang Jian besieged Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 蜀州刺史周德權言於建曰：「公與彥暉爭東川三年，士卒疲於矢石，百姓困於輸輓。

translations.literal: Shuzhou Prefect Zhou Dequan said to Jian: "Your Excellency has contended with Yanhui for Dongchuan for three years; soldiers are weary of arrows and stones, and the people are distressed by transport and supply.
translations.idiomatic: Shuzhou Prefect Zhou Dequan said to Wang Jian: "Your Excellency has contended with Gu Yanhui for Dongchuan for three years; soldiers are weary of arrows and stones, and the people are distressed by transport and supply.

sentences.zh: 東川群盜多據州縣，彥暉懦而無謀，欲為偷安之計，皆啗以厚利，恃其救援，故堅守不下。

translations.literal: The bandits of Dongchuan mostly hold prefectures and counties. Yanhui is timid and without strategy, wishing only to steal a moment's peace; all are fed with rich rewards and rely on his rescue—hence they hold firm and will not submit.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits of Dongchuan mostly hold prefectures and counties. Gu Yanhui is timid and without strategy, wishing only to steal a moment's peace; all are fed with rich rewards and rely on his rescue—hence they hold firm and will not submit.

sentences.zh: 今若遣人諭賊帥以禍福，來者賞之以官，不服者威之以兵，則彼之所恃，反為我用矣。」

translations.literal: If you now send men to instruct the bandit chiefs on fortune and disaster—those who come in rewarded with office, those who do not submit awed with troops—then what they rely on will turn to your use."
translations.idiomatic: If you now send men to instruct the bandit chiefs on fortune and disaster—rewarding those who come in with office and awing those who do not submit with troops—then what they rely on will turn to your use."

sentences.zh: 建從之，彥暉勢益孤。

translations.literal: Jian followed this advice, and Yanhui's position grew ever more isolated.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian followed this advice, and Gu Yanhui's position grew ever more isolated.

sentences.zh: 德權，許州人也。

translations.literal: Dequan was a native of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Dequan was a native of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，李克用至安塞軍，辛巳，攻之。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Li Keyong reached Anse Army; on xinsi, he attacked it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Li Keyong reached Anse Army; on xinsi, he attacked it.

sentences.zh: 幽州將單可及引騎兵至，克用方飲酒，前鋒曰：「賊至矣。」

translations.literal: Youzhou general Shan Keji led cavalry up. Keyong was just drinking wine. The vanguard said: "The enemy has come."
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou general Shan Keji led cavalry up. Li Keyong was just drinking wine. The vanguard said, "The enemy has come."

sentences.zh: 克用醉，曰：「仁恭何在？」

translations.literal: Keyong, drunk, said: "Where is Rengong?"
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong, drunk, said, "Where is Liu Rengong?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「但見可及輩。」

translations.literal: They replied: "We only see Keji and his sort."
translations.idiomatic: They replied, "We only see Shan Keji and his sort."

sentences.zh: 克用瞋目曰：「可及輩何足為敵！」

translations.literal: Keyong glared and said: "Keji and his sort are hardly fit to be enemies!"
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong glared and said, "Shan Keji and his sort are hardly fit to be enemies!"

sentences.zh: 亟命擊之。

translations.literal: He urgently ordered an attack.
translations.idiomatic: He urgently ordered an attack.

sentences.zh: 是日大霧，不辨人物，幽州將楊師侃伏兵於木瓜澗，河東兵大敗，失亡太半。

translations.literal: That day there was heavy fog and figures could not be distinguished. Youzhou general Yang Shikan ambushed troops at Mugua Stream; Hedong troops were greatly defeated and lost more than half their number.
translations.idiomatic: That day there was heavy fog and figures could not be distinguished. Youzhou general Yang Shikan ambushed troops at Mugua Stream; Hedong troops were greatly defeated and lost more than half their number.

sentences.zh: 會大風雨震電，幽州兵解去。

translations.literal: Just then great wind, rain, thunder, and lightning came; Youzhou troops dispersed and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Just then great wind, rain, thunder, and lightning came; Youzhou troops dispersed and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 克用醒而後知敗，責大將李存信等曰：「吾以醉廢事，汝曹何不力爭！」

translations.literal: When Keyong sobered up he then learned of the defeat and rebuked the great generals Li Cunxin and others, saying: "I let drink ruin affairs—why did you not strive with all your might!"
translations.idiomatic: When Li Keyong sobered up he then learned of the defeat and rebuked the senior generals Li Cunxin and others, saying, "I let drink ruin affairs—why did you not strive with all your might!"

sentences.zh: 湖州刺史李彥徽欲以州附於楊行密，其眾不從。

translations.literal: Huzhou Prefect Li Yanhui wished to surrender the prefecture to Yang Xingmi, but his followers would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Huzhou Prefect Li Yanhui wished to surrender the prefecture to Yang Xingmi, but his followers would not agree.

sentences.zh: 彥徽奔廣陵，都指揮使沈攸以州歸錢鏐。

translations.literal: Yanhui fled to Guangling; commander-in-chief Shen You surrendered the prefecture to Qian Liu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yanhui fled to Guangling; commander-in-chief Shen You surrendered the prefecture to Qian Liu.

sentences.zh: 以彰義節度使張璉為鳳翔西北行營招討使，以討李茂貞。

translations.literal: Zhangyi military governor Zhang Lian was made commissioner for suppressing and recruiting of the Fengxiang northwest campaign headquarters to attack Li Maozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangyi military governor Zhang Lian was made commissioner for suppressing and recruiting of the Fengxiang northwest campaign headquarters to attack Li Maozhen.

sentences.zh: 復以王建為西川節度使、同平章事。

translations.literal: Wang Jian was again made Xichuan military governor and Co-Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian was again appointed Xichuan military governor and Co-Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 加義武節度使王郜同平章事。

translations.literal: Yiwu military governor Wang Gao was given the additional title of Co-Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwu military governor Wang Gao was given the additional title of Co-Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 削奪新西川節度使李茂貞官爵，複姓名宋文通。

translations.literal: The new Xichuan military governor Li Maozhen was stripped of office and rank, and his original personal name Song Wentong was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The new Xichuan military governor Li Maozhen was stripped of office and rank, and his original personal name Song Wentong was restored.

sentences.zh: 朱全忠既得兗、鄆，甲兵益盛，乃大舉擊楊行密，遣龐師古以徐、宿、宋、滑之兵七萬壁清口，將趣揚州，葛從周以兗、鄆、曹、濮之兵壁安豐，將趨壽州，全忠自將頓宿州。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong, having already taken Yan and Yanzhou, his armor and troops ever more powerful, thereupon launched a major attack on Yang Xingmi. He sent Pang Shigu with seventy thousand troops from Xu, Su, Song, and Hua to encamp at Qingkou, intending to advance on Yangzhou; Ge Congzhou with troops from Yan, Yanzhou, Cao, and Pu encamped at Anfeng, intending to advance on Shouzhou; Quanzhong personally commanded and halted at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong, having already taken Yan and Yanzhou, his forces ever more powerful, thereupon launched a major attack on Yang Xingmi. He sent Pang Shigu with seventy thousand troops from Xu, Su, Song, and Hua to encamp at Qingkou, intending to advance on Yangzhou; Ge Congzhou with troops from Yan, Yanzhou, Cao, and Pu encamped at Anfeng, intending to advance on Shouzhou; Quanzhong personally commanded and halted at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 淮南震恐。

translations.literal: Huainan was shaken with terror.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan was shaken with terror.

sentences.zh: 匡國節度使李繼瑭聞朝廷討李茂貞而懼，韓建復從而搖之，繼瑭奔鳳翔。

translations.literal: Kuangguo military governor Li Jitang heard that the court was attacking Li Maozhen and was afraid; Han Jian again swayed him from the side, and Jitang fled to Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Kuangguo military governor Li Jitang heard that the court was attacking Li Maozhen and was afraid; Han Jian again swayed him from the side, and Li Jitang fled to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，以建為鎮國、匡國兩軍節度使。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Jian was made military governor of both the Zhenguo and Kuangguo armies.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, Han Jian was made military governor of both the Zhenguo and Kuangguo armies.

sentences.zh: 壬子，知遂州侯紹帥眾二萬，乙卯，知合州王仁威帥眾千人，戊午，鳳翔將李繼溥以援兵二千，皆降於王建。

translations.literal: On renzi, Acting Prefect of Suizhou Hou Shao led twenty thousand followers; on yimao, Acting Prefect of Hezhou Wang Renwei led a thousand followers; on wuwu, Fengxiang general Li Jipu with two thousand relief troops—all surrendered to Wang Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Acting Prefect of Suizhou Hou Shao led twenty thousand followers; on yimao, Acting Prefect of Hezhou Wang Renwei led a thousand followers; on wuwu, Fengxiang general Li Jipu with two thousand relief troops—all surrendered to Wang Jian.

sentences.zh: 建攻梓州益急。

translations.literal: Jian pressed the attack on Zizhou ever more urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian pressed the attack on Zizhou ever more urgently.

sentences.zh: 庚申，顧彥暉聚其宗族及假子共飲，遣王宗弼自歸於建。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Gu Yanhui gathered his clan and adopted sons to drink together, and sent Wang Zongbi to surrender himself to Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Gu Yanhui gathered his clan and adopted sons to drink together, and sent Wang Zongbi to surrender himself to Wang Jian.

sentences.zh: 酒酣，命其假子瑤殺己及同飲者，然後自殺。

translations.literal: When the wine had gone deep, he ordered his adopted son Yao to kill him and those drinking with him, and then to kill himself.
translations.idiomatic: When the wine had gone deep, he ordered his adopted son Yao to kill him and those drinking with him, and then to kill himself.

sentences.zh: 建入梓州，城中兵尚七萬人，建命王宗綰分兵徇昌、普等州，以王宗滌為東川留後。

translations.literal: Jian entered Zizhou. Troops in the city still numbered seventy thousand. Jian ordered Wang Zongwan to divide troops and subdue Chang, Pu, and other prefectures, and made Wang Zongdi acting military governor of Dongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian entered Zizhou. Troops in the city still numbered seventy thousand. Wang Jian ordered Wang Zongwan to divide troops and subdue Chang, Pu, and other prefectures, and made Wang Zongdi acting military governor of Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 劉仁恭奏稱：「李克用無故稱兵見討，本道大破其黨於木瓜澗，請自為統帥以討克用。」

translations.literal: Liu Rengong memorialized, stating: "Li Keyong for no reason raised troops and came to attack me. This circuit greatly defeated his faction at Mugua Stream. I ask to serve as commander-in-chief myself to campaign against Keyong."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rengong memorialized, stating, "Li Keyong for no reason raised troops and came to attack me. This circuit greatly defeated his faction at Mugua Stream. I ask to serve as commander-in-chief myself to campaign against Li Keyong."

sentences.zh: 詔不許。

translations.literal: An edict did not grant this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict did not grant this.

sentences.zh: 又遺朱全忠書。

translations.literal: He also sent a letter to Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent a letter to Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 全忠奏加仁恭同平章事，朝廷從之。

translations.literal: Quanzhong memorialized that Rengong be given the additional title of Co-Grand Councillor, and the court complied.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong memorialized that Liu Rengong be given the additional title of Co-Grand Councillor, and the court complied.

sentences.zh: 仁恭又遣使謝克用，陳去就不自安之意。

translations.literal: Rengong also sent envoys to thank Keyong and explain that he felt insecure in his going and staying.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rengong also sent envoys to thank Li Keyong and explain that he felt insecure in his position.

sentences.zh: 克用復書略曰：「今公仗金戊控兵，理民立法，擢士則欲其報德，選將則望彼酬恩。

translations.literal: Keyong replied in a letter, in summary: "Now Your Excellency wields the golden spear and controls troops, governs the people and establishes laws, promotes scholars and wishes them to repay virtue, selects generals and hopes they will requite favor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong replied in a letter, in summary: "Now Your Excellency wields the golden spear and controls troops, governs the people and establishes laws, promotes scholars and wishes them to repay virtue, selects generals and hopes they will requite favor.

sentences.zh: 己尚不然，人何足信！

translations.literal: If you yourself are not yet so, how can people be trusted!
translations.idiomatic: If you yourself are not yet so, how can people be trusted!

sentences.zh: 僕料猜防出於骨肉，嫌忌生於屏帷，持干將而不敢授人，捧盟盤而何詞著誓！」

translations.literal: Your servant surmises that suspicion and guard arise from one's own flesh and blood, that jealousy is born within the screen and curtain, that one holds the Ganjiang sword yet dares not entrust it to others, and that one clasps the covenant platter yet has no words with which to swear an oath!"
translations.idiomatic: I surmise that suspicion and guard arise from one's own flesh and blood, that jealousy is born within the screen and curtain, that one holds the Ganjiang sword yet dares not entrust it to others, and that one clasps the covenant platter yet has no words with which to swear an oath!"

sentences.zh: 甲子，立皇子祕為景王，祚為輝王，祺為祁王。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the emperor's sons Mi, Zuo, and Qi were established as Princes of Jing, Hui, and Qi respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the emperor's sons Mi, Zuo, and Qi were established as Princes of Jing, Hui, and Qi respectively.

sentences.zh: 加彰義節度使張璉同平章事。

translations.literal: Zhangyi military governor Zhang Lian was given the additional title of Co-Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangyi military governor Zhang Lian was given the additional title of Co-Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 楊行密與朱瑾將兵三萬拒汴軍於楚州，別將張訓自漣水引兵會之，行密以為前鋒。

translations.literal: Yang Xingmi and Zhu Jin led thirty thousand troops to resist Bian troops at Chuzhou. Separate general Zhang Xun led troops from Lianshui to join them; Xingmi made him vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi and Zhu Jin led thirty thousand troops to resist Bian troops at Chuzhou. Separate general Zhang Xun led troops from Lianshui to join them; Yang Xingmi made him vanguard.

sentences.zh: 龐師古營於清口，或曰：「營地汙下，不可久處。」

translations.literal: Pang Shigu encamped at Qingkou. Someone said: "The camp ground is low and wet; one cannot stay long."
translations.idiomatic: Pang Shigu encamped at Qingkou. Someone said, "The camp ground is low and wet; one cannot stay long."

sentences.zh: 不聽。

translations.literal: He did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: He did not listen.

sentences.zh: 師古恃眾輕敵，居常弈棋。

translations.literal: Shigu relied on his numbers and despised the enemy; in ordinary times he played chess.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Shigu relied on his numbers and despised the enemy; in ordinary times he played chess.

sentences.zh: 朱瑾壅淮上流，欲灌之。

translations.literal: Zhu Jin dammed the upper Huai and wished to flood the camp.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Jin dammed the upper Huai and wished to flood the camp.

sentences.zh: 或以告師古，師古以為惑眾，斬之。

translations.literal: Someone reported this to Shigu; Shigu thought it was spreading panic among the troops and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Someone reported this to Pang Shigu; Shigu thought it was spreading panic among the troops and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 十一月，癸酉，瑾與淮南將侯瓚將五千騎潛渡淮，用汴人旗幟，自北來趣其中軍，張訓逾柵而入。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Jin and Huainan general Hou Zan led five thousand cavalry to cross the Huai in secret, using Bian banners and flags, and came from the north toward the center of their army; Zhang Xun crossed the palisade and entered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Zhu Jin and Huainan general Hou Zan led five thousand cavalry to cross the Huai in secret, using Bian banners and flags, and came from the north toward the center of their army; Zhang Xun crossed the palisade and entered.

sentences.zh: 士卒蒼黃拒戰，淮水大至，汴軍駭亂。

translations.literal: Soldiers fought in panic; the Huai waters rose greatly, and Bian troops were terrified and thrown into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers fought in panic; the Huai waters rose greatly, and Bian troops were terrified and thrown into disorder.

sentences.zh: 行密引大軍濟淮，與瑾等夾攻之，汴軍大敗。

translations.literal: Xingmi led the main army across the Huai and, together with Jin and the others, attacked them from both sides; Bian troops were greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi led the main army across the Huai and, together with Zhu Jin and the others, attacked them from both sides; Bian troops were greatly defeated.

sentences.zh: 斬師古及將士首萬餘級，餘眾皆潰。

translations.literal: Shigu and more than ten thousand heads of officers and soldiers were beheaded; the remaining followers all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Shigu and more than ten thousand heads of officers and soldiers were beheaded; the remaining followers all fled.

sentences.zh: 葛從周屯於壽州西北，壽州團練使朱延壽擊破之，退屯濠州，聞師古敗，奔還。

translations.literal: Ge Congzhou was encamped northwest of Shouzhou; Shouzhou training commissioner Zhu Yanshou defeated him. He withdrew to encamp at Haozhou; hearing of Shigu's defeat, he fled back.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Congzhou was encamped northwest of Shouzhou; Shouzhou training commissioner Zhu Yanshou defeated him. He withdrew to encamp at Haozhou; hearing of Pang Shigu's defeat, he fled back.

sentences.zh: 行密、瑾、延壽乘勝追之，及於淠水。

translations.literal: Xingmi, Jin, and Yanshou pursued them on the momentum of victory and caught up at the Pi River.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi, Zhu Jin, and Zhu Yanshou pursued them on the momentum of victory and caught up at the Pi River.

sentences.zh: 從周半濟，淮南兵擊之，殺溺殆盡，從周走免。

translations.literal: Congzhou was halfway across when Huainan troops attacked; those killed and drowned were nearly all; Congzhou fled and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Congzhou was halfway across when Huainan troops attacked; those killed and drowned were nearly all; Ge Congzhou fled and escaped.

sentences.zh: 遏後都指揮使牛存節棄馬步鬥，諸軍稍得濟淮，凡四日不食，會大雪，汴卒緣道凍餒死，還者不滿千人。

translations.literal: Rear-guard commander Niu Cunjie abandoned his horse and fought on foot; the various armies gradually managed to cross the Huai. For four days they did not eat; heavy snow came; Bian soldiers along the road died of cold and hunger; those who returned numbered fewer than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Rear-guard commander Niu Cunjie abandoned his horse and fought on foot; the various armies gradually managed to cross the Huai. For four days they did not eat; heavy snow came; Bian soldiers along the road died of cold and hunger; those who returned numbered fewer than a thousand.

sentences.zh: 全忠聞敗，亦奔還。

translations.literal: When Quanzhong heard of the defeat, he too fled back.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhu Quanzhong heard of the defeat, he too fled back.

sentences.zh: 行密遺全忠書曰：「龐師古、葛從周，非敵也，公宜來淮上決戰。」

translations.literal: Xingmi sent Quanzhong a letter saying: "Pang Shigu and Ge Congzhou are no match as enemies; Your Excellency ought to come to the Huai for a decisive battle."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi sent Zhu Quanzhong a letter saying, "Pang Shigu and Ge Congzhou are no match as enemies; you ought to come to the Huai for a decisive battle."

sentences.zh: 行密大會諸將，謂行軍副使李承嗣曰：「始吾欲先趣壽州，副使雲不如先向清口。

translations.literal: Xingmi held a great assembly of generals and said to Campaign Deputy Li Chengsi: "At first I wished to advance first on Shouzhou; the deputy said it would be better to go first to Qingkou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi held a great assembly of generals and said to Campaign Deputy Li Chengsi, "At first I wished to advance first on Shouzhou; you said it would be better to go first to Qingkou.

sentences.zh: 師古敗，從周自走，今果如所料。」

translations.literal: Shigu was defeated and Congzhou fled on his own—now it has indeed turned out as you foresaw."
translations.idiomatic: Pang Shigu was defeated and Ge Congzhou fled on his own—now it has indeed turned out as you foresaw."

sentences.zh: 賞之錢萬緡，表承嗣領鎮海節度使。

translations.literal: He rewarded him with ten thousand strings of cash and memorialized that Chengsi should head the Zhenhai governorship.
translations.idiomatic: He rewarded him with ten thousand strings of cash and memorialized that Li Chengsi should be appointed military governor of Zhenhai.

sentences.zh: 行密待承嗣及史儼甚厚，第捨、姬妾，鹹選其尤者賜之，故二人為行密盡力，屢立功，竟卒於淮南。

translations.literal: Xingmi treated Chengsi and Shi Yan very generously, selecting the finest of mansions and concubines to bestow on them; therefore the two served Xingmi with all their strength, repeatedly achieving merit, and in the end died in Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi treated Li Chengsi and Shi Yan very generously, selecting the finest of mansions and concubines to bestow on them; therefore the two served Yang Xingmi with all their strength, repeatedly achieving merit, and in the end died in Huainan.

sentences.zh: 行密由是遂保據江、淮之間，全忠不能與之爭。

translations.literal: Xingmi thereby secured and held the region between the Yangtze and the Huai; Quanzhong could not contend with him.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xingmi thereby secured and held the region between the Yangtze and the Huai; Zhu Quanzhong could not contend with him.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，立淑妃何氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Pure Consort He was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Pure Consort He was established as empress.

sentences.zh: 后，東川人，生德王、輝王。

translations.literal: She was a native of Dongchuan and bore the Princes of De and Hui.
translations.idiomatic: She was a native of Dongchuan and bore the Princes of De and Hui.

sentences.zh: 威武節度使王潮弟審知，為觀察副使，有過，潮猶加捶撻，審知無怨色。

translations.literal: Weiwu military governor Wang Chao's younger brother Shenzhi served as observation deputy commissioner; when he had faults, Chao still beat him with the staff, yet Shenzhi showed no resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Weiwu military governor Wang Chao's younger brother Shenzhi served as observation deputy commissioner; when he had faults, Chao still beat him with the staff, yet Shenzhi showed no resentment.

sentences.zh: 潮寢疾，捨其子延興、延虹、延豐、延休，命審知知軍府事。

translations.literal: When Chao took to his bed with illness, he set aside his sons Yanxing, Yanhong, Yanfeng, and Yanxiu and ordered Shenzhi to manage military headquarters affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Chao took to his bed with illness, he set aside his sons Yanxing, Yanhong, Yanfeng, and Yanxiu and ordered Shenzhi to manage military headquarters affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丁未，潮薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingwei, Chao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingwei, Wang Chao died.

sentences.zh: 審知以讓其兄泉州刺史審邽，審邽以審知有功，辭不受。

translations.literal: Shenzhi wished to yield the post to his elder brother Quanzhou Prefect Shengui; Shengui, because Shenzhi had merit, declined and would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzhi wished to yield the post to his elder brother Quanzhou Prefect Shengui; Shengui, because Shenzhi had merit, declined and would not accept.

sentences.zh: 審知自稱福建留後，表於朝廷。

translations.literal: Shenzhi styled himself acting military governor of Fujian and memorialized the court.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzhi styled himself acting military governor of Fujian and memorialized the court.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，王建自梓州還。

translations.literal: On renxu, Wang Jian returned from Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wang Jian returned from Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，至成都。

translations.literal: On wuchen, he reached Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, he reached Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 是歲，南詔驃信舜化有上皇帝書函及督爽牒中書木夾，年號中興。

translations.literal: That year, Nanzhao Biaoxin Shunhua had an imperial letter-case presented to the emperor and a dispatch from the Supervisor of Envoys in a wooden folder to the Secretariat, with the era name Zhongxing.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Nanzhao Biaoxin Shunhua presented an imperial letter-case to the emperor and a dispatch from the Supervisor of Envoys in a wooden folder to the Secretariat, with the era name Zhongxing.

sentences.zh: 朝廷欲以詔書報之。

translations.literal: The court wished to reply with an imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: The court wished to answer with an imperial edict.

sentences.zh: 王建上言：「南詔小夷，不足辱詔書。

translations.literal: Wang Jian memorialized: "Nanzhao is a petty tribe, unworthy of the dishonor of an imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jian memorialized, "Nanzhao is a petty frontier state; it does not deserve the honor of an imperial edict in reply.

sentences.zh: 臣在西南，彼必不敢犯塞。」

translations.literal: While your servant holds the southwest, they will surely not dare violate the border passes."
translations.idiomatic: While I hold the southwest, they will surely not dare raid the frontier."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court complied.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 黎、雅間有淺蠻曰劉王、郝王、楊王，各有部落，西川歲賜繒帛三千匹，使覘南詔，亦受南詔賂詗成都虛實。

translations.literal: Between Li and Ya were shallow barbarians called King Liu, King Hao, and King Yang, each with his own tribe; Xichuan yearly bestowed three thousand bolts of silk on them to spy on Nanzhao, yet they also accepted Nanzhao bribes to reconnoiter Chengdu's strength and weakness.
translations.idiomatic: Between Li and Ya lived shallow tribes known as Kings Liu, Hao, and Yang, each with his own following; Xichuan granted them three thousand bolts of silk every year to watch Nanzhao, yet they also took Nanzhao bribes to spy out Chengdu's defenses.

sentences.zh: 每節度使到官，三王帥酋長詣府，節度使自謂威德所致，表於朝廷。

translations.literal: Whenever a military governor arrived to take office, the three kings would lead their chieftains to the headquarters; the governor would take this as the effect of his prestige and virtue and memorialize the court.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a new military governor took office, the three kings would lead their chieftains to his headquarters; the governor would credit his own prestige and virtue and report the fact to the court.

sentences.zh: 而三王陰與大將相表裡，節度使或失大將心，則教諸蠻紛擾。

translations.literal: Yet the three kings secretly acted in concert with the chief generals; if a governor lost a general's favor, the general would incite the various tribes to make trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the three kings secretly colluded with the senior generals; if a governor lost a general's support, the general would stir the tribes into disorder.

sentences.zh: 先是節度使多文臣，不欲生事，故大將常籍此以邀姑息，而南詔亦憑之屢為邊患。

translations.literal: Earlier, military governors were mostly civil officials who did not wish to stir up trouble, so generals often used this to demand indulgence, and Nanzhao likewise relied on it to make repeated border troubles.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, most governors had been civil officials who avoided trouble, so generals often exploited the arrangement to demand concessions, and Nanzhao repeatedly turned it to border raids.

sentences.zh: 及王建鎮西川，絕其舊賜，斬都押牙山行章以懲之。

translations.literal: When Wang Jian governed Xichuan, he cut off the old gifts and executed Chief Military Adjutant Shan Xingzhang as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Jian took command of Xichuan, he ended the old subsidies and executed Chief Military Adjutant Shan Xingzhang to make an example.

sentences.zh: 邛崍之南，不置鄣候，不戍一卒，蠻亦不敢侵盜。

translations.literal: South of Qionglai he set up no frontier posts and garrisoned not a single soldier, yet the tribes also did not dare raid or plunder.
translations.idiomatic: South of Qionglai he posted no frontier guards and stationed not a single soldier, yet the tribes did not dare raid or plunder.

sentences.zh: 其後遣王宗播擊南詔，三王漏洩軍事，召而斬之。

translations.literal: Later he sent Wang Zongbo to attack Nanzhao; the three kings leaked military intelligence, were summoned, and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Later he sent Wang Zongbo against Nanzhao; the three kings leaked campaign plans, were summoned in, and executed.

sentences.zh: 右拾遺張道古上疏，稱：「國家有五危、二亂。

translations.literal: Right Reminder Zhang Daogu submitted a memorial, stating: "The state has five perils and two disorders.
translations.idiomatic: Right Reminder Zhang Daogu submitted a memorial, saying, "The realm faces five perils and two disorders.

sentences.zh: 昔漢文帝即位未幾，明習國家事。

translations.literal: Formerly, when Emperor Wen of Han had been on the throne only a short while, he was already well versed in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity, Emperor Wen of Han had barely taken the throne when he already understood the business of government.

sentences.zh: 今陛下登極已十年，而曾不知為君馭臣之道。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty has ascended the throne for ten years, yet you have never understood the way of a ruler in controlling his ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has reigned ten years, yet you still do not grasp how a ruler masters his ministers.

sentences.zh: 太宗內安中原，外開四夷，海表之國，莫不入臣。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong pacified the Central Plains within and opened the four barbarians without; states beyond the seas, none failed to enter his service as subjects.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong secured the heartland within and opened the four quarters without; every state beyond the seas submitted as a vassal.

sentences.zh: 今先朝封域，日蹙幾盡。

translations.literal: Now the former dynasty's domains shrink day by day, nearly exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Now the domains of the former reign dwindle daily, all but gone.

sentences.zh: 臣雖微賤，竊傷陛下朝廷社稷始為奸臣弄，終為賊臣所有也。」

translations.literal: Though your servant is mean and lowly, I secretly grieve that Your Majesty's court and altars of soil and grain were first toyed with by treacherous ministers and will in the end be possessed by rebel ministers."
translations.idiomatic: Humble though I am, I grieve that Your Majesty's court and altars were first toyed with by treacherous ministers and will end in the hands of rebel ministers."

sentences.zh: 上怒，貶道古施州司戶。

translations.literal: The emperor was enraged and demoted Daogu to Registrar of Shizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enraged and demoted Zhang Daogu to registrar of Shizhou.

sentences.zh: 仍下詔罪狀道古，宣示諫官。

translations.literal: He also issued an edict listing Daogu's crimes and displayed it to the remonstrance officials.
translations.idiomatic: He also issued an edict enumerating Zhang Daogu's offenses and circulated it among the remonstrance officials.

sentences.zh: 道古，青州人也。

translations.literal: Daogu was a man of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Daogu was a native of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 昭宗聖穆景文孝皇帝中之上光化元年（

translations.literal: The middle section, upper part, of the reign of Emperor Zhaozong, the Sagely, Solemn, Illustrious, Cultured, and Filial—Guanghua, year one (
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhaozong—middle section, upper part—Guanghua, year one (

sentences.zh: 戊午，公元八九八年）

translations.literal: wuwu, corresponding to the year 898 of the Common Era)
translations.idiomatic: wuwu, corresponding to 898 CE)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，兩浙、江西、武昌、淄青各遣使詣闕，請以朱全忠為都統，討楊行密。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, Liang-Zhe, Jiangxi, Wuchang, and Ziqing each sent envoys to the court, asking that Zhu Quanzhong be made supreme commander to attack Yang Xingmi.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, Liang-Zhe, Jiangxi, Wuchang, and Ziqing each sent envoys to court, asking that Zhu Quanzhong be appointed supreme commander to campaign against Yang Xingmi.

sentences.zh: 詔不許。

translations.literal: An edict did not grant this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict refused the request.

sentences.zh: 加平盧節度使王師範同平章事。

translations.literal: Pinglu military governor Wang Shifan was given the additional title of Co-Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: The court made Pinglu military governor Wang Shifan Co-Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 以兵部尚書劉崇望同平章事，充東川節度使。

translations.literal: Minister of War Liu Chongwang was made Co-Grand Councillor and appointed Dongchuan military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Liu Chongwang was made Co-Grand Councillor and appointed military governor of Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 以昭信防禦使馮行襲為昭信節度使。

translations.literal: Zhaoxin defense commissioner Feng Xingxi was made Zhaoxin military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoxin defense commissioner Feng Xingxi was appointed military governor of Zhaoxin.

sentences.zh: 上下詔罪己息兵，復李茂貞姓名官爵，應諸道討鳳翔兵皆罷之。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict blaming himself and halting hostilities, restored Li Maozhen's name and office and rank, and disbanded all troops from the various circuits campaigning against Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued an edict of self-reproach and ordered a halt to fighting, restored Li Maozhen's name, offices, and titles, and disbanded every circuit army sent against Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，河中節度使王珂親迎於晉陽，李克用遣其將李嗣昭守河中。

translations.literal: On renchen, Hezhong military governor Wang Ke went in person to welcome his bride at Jinyang; Li Keyong sent his general Li Sizhao to guard Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Hezhong military governor Wang Ke went in person to Jinyang for his wedding; Li Keyong sent his general Li Sizhao to hold Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 李茂貞、韓建皆致書於李克用，言大駕出幸累年，乞修和好，同獎王室，兼乞丁匠助修宮室，克用許之。

translations.literal: Li Maozhen and Han Jian both sent letters to Li Keyong, saying the imperial carriage had been on tour for many years, begging to restore friendly relations and jointly support the royal house, and also begging for laborers and craftsmen to help repair the palace halls; Keyong agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Maozhen and Han Jian both wrote Li Keyong, saying the emperor had been away from the capital for years, asking to restore friendly ties and jointly uphold the throne, and also requesting laborers and craftsmen to help repair the palaces; Li Keyong agreed.

sentences.zh: 初，王建攻東川，顧彥暉求救於李茂貞，茂貞命將出兵救之，不暇東逼乘輿，詐稱改過，與韓建共翼戴天子。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Wang Jian attacked Dongchuan, Gu Yanhui sought rescue from Li Maozhen; Maozhen ordered a general to lead troops to save him, had no leisure to press east against the imperial carriage, falsely claimed he had mended his ways, and together with Han Jian supported and upheld the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Wang Jian attacked Dongchuan, Gu Yanhui sought aid from Li Maozhen; Maozhen ordered a general to relieve him, had no time to march east against the emperor, feigned repentance, and together with Han Jian pledged to uphold the throne.

sentences.zh: 及聞朱全忠營洛陽宮，累表迎車駕，茂貞、韓建懼，請修復宮闕，奉上歸長安。

translations.literal: When they heard that Zhu Quanzhong was building palaces at Luoyang and repeatedly memorialized to welcome the imperial carriage, Maozhen and Han Jian grew afraid, asked to repair the palace halls, and offered to escort the emperor back to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: When they learned that Zhu Quanzhong was building palaces at Luoyang and repeatedly asked the court to move the capital there, Maozhen and Han Jian were afraid, petitioned to restore the palaces, and offered to bring the emperor back to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 詔以韓建為修宮闕使。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Han Jian commissioner for repairing the palace halls.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Han Jian commissioner for restoring the palaces.

sentences.zh: 諸道皆助錢及工材。

translations.literal: All the circuits contributed money and labor materials.
translations.idiomatic: Every circuit contributed funds and building materials.

sentences.zh: 建使都將蔡敬思督其役。

translations.literal: Jian had his chief commander Cai Jingsi supervise the work.
translations.idiomatic: Han Jian had his chief commander Cai Jingsi supervise the project.

sentences.zh: 既成，二月，建自往視之。

translations.literal: When it was finished, in the second month Jian went in person to inspect it.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was finished, in the second month Han Jian went in person to inspect it.

sentences.zh: 錢鏐請徙鎮海軍於杭州，從之。
